content: In the sentence "The apple does not fit into the box because it is too big," the pronoun "it" refers to "the apple." The structure of the sentence suggests that the reason the apple cannot fit into the box is that the apple itself is too big. If "it" were referring to "the box," the sentence would more likely say that the box is too small for the apple to fit. Thus, in this context, "it" clearly indicates that the apple is too big.
